name: Clay paste extrusion
summary: A printer pushes soft clay through a nozzle and builds a form in thin layers. A computer file sets the path of the nozzle.
how: Draw the form in software and slice it into layers of 1 to 2 mm.
Load soft clay into the cylinder of the printer.
Press the clay through a nozzle of 1 to 4 mm and build the wall layer by layer.
Dry the form slowly, glaze it and fire it.

origin.note: Designers fit clay cylinders to small 3D printers and print vessels in ceramic paste.

adoptions.via: Designers print vases with visible layer lines and fire them as plain earthenware, stoneware or porcelain.
